sheet-name.purpose: The state name at the top of the detail sheet.

body.purpose: Sheet status line, buttons, dialog copy.

legend.purpose: Legend pill name; the count is 900.

chip.purpose: Two-letter abbreviations on the small-state chips.

map-label.purpose: State abbreviations in SVG units: 22px phone (19px lit mid-size), 15px from 700px, 13px from 1200px.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The sheet, the share dialog, the login card, and the card preview. The only shadow.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Hairline on beige inputs, empty chips, and the icon button.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Control color/transform, state fill and filter.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: A changed state, around its own center (transform-box: fill-box).

motion.name: wipe
motion.purpose: A white overlay clipped to the changed state.

motion.name: long-press
motion.purpose: Hold a state or chip to open the sheet; Shift+Enter is the keyboard equivalent.

components.name: Button
components.description: Beige pill; the primary variant is ink with white text.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface2, #f3ede4); color: var(--ink, #3b3540); font: 800 1rem/1 Nunito, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn--primary { background: var(--ink, #3b3540); color: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #4a8fd0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Small states and DC as chips; fill by mark, a dot when the state has a note.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 56px; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface2, #f3ede4); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line, #e8dfd3); color: var(--ink, #3b3540); font: 800 0.875rem/1 Nunito, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip--aaron { background: var(--aaron, #79b4e8); box-shadow: none; } .ds-chip--riley { background: var(--riley, #f08a9b); box-shadow: none; } .ds-chip--together { background: var(--together, #a98bdc); box-shadow: none; } .ds-chip--both { box-shadow: none; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--aaron, #79b4e8) 0 5px, var(--riley, #f08a9b) 5px 10px); } .ds-chip__note { position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 5px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #3b3540); opacity: .75; }

components.name: Legend pill
components.description: Swatch, name, count, in the mark's tint.
components.html:
• Aaron 12
  • Riley 9
  • Both 4
  • Together 6
components.css: .ds-legend { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; font: 700 0.9375rem/1 Nunito, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #3b3540); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-legend__item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface2, #f3ede4); } .ds-legend__item b { font-weight: 900; } .ds-swatch { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--empty, #e9e2da); } .ds-legend__item--aaron { background: var(--aaron-tint, #d6e8f8); } .ds-legend__item--aaron .ds-swatch { background: var(--aaron, #79b4e8); } .ds-legend__item--riley { background: var(--riley-tint, #fbd9df); } .ds-legend__item--riley .ds-swatch { background: var(--riley, #f08a9b); } .ds-legend__item--together { background: var(--together-tint, #e6dcf5); } .ds-legend__item--together .ds-swatch { background: var(--together, #a98bdc); } .ds-legend__item--both .ds-swatch { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--aaron, #79b4e8) 0 3px, var(--riley, #f08a9b) 3px 6px); }

components.name: Toggle (sheet)
components.description: Per-person pill in the person's tint; solid when pressed, with a ring that fills.
components.css: .ds-toggles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; max-width: 420px; } .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 14px 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink, #3b3540); font: 800 1.0625rem/1 Nunito, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle--aaron { background: var(--aaron-tint, #d6e8f8); } .ds-toggle--riley { background: var(--riley-tint, #fbd9df); } .ds-toggle--aaron[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--aaron, #79b4e8); } .ds-toggle--riley[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--riley, #f08a9b); } .ds-toggle__mark { position: relative; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #3b3540); opacity: .45; } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-toggle__mark { opacity: 1; background: var(--ink, #3b3540); } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-toggle__mark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface, #fff); }

components.name: Map state
components.description: Puzzle pieces: a fill with the page color between states; ink labels on any mark.
components.html: <svg class="ds-map" viewBox="0 0 400 90" aria-label="Five state marks"><g class="ds-state" data-mark="0"><rect class="ds-state__fill" x="8" y="10" width="70" height="70" rx="6"/><text class="ds-state__label" x="43" y="45">MT</text></g><g class="ds-state" data-mark="1"><rect class="ds-state__fill" x="86" y="10" width="70" height="70" rx="6"/><text class="ds-state__label" x="121" y="45">WA</text></g><g class="ds-state" data-mark="2"><rect class="ds-state__fill" x="164" y="10" width="70" height="70" rx="6"/><text class="ds-state__label" x="199" y="45">OH</text></g><g class="ds-state" data-mark="3"><rect class="ds-state__fill" x="242" y="10" width="70" height="70" rx="6"/><text class="ds-state__label" x="277" y="45">AZ</text></g><g class="ds-state" data-mark="7"><rect class="ds-state__fill" x="320" y="10" width="70" height="70" rx="6"/><text class="ds-state__label" x="355" y="45">VT</text></g></svg>
components.css: .ds-map { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 400px; background: var(--bg, #fff8f0); border-radius: 12px; font-family: Nunito, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-state { cursor: pointer; } .ds-state__fill { fill: var(--empty, #e9e2da); stroke: var(--bg, #fff8f0); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-state[data-mark='1'] .ds-state__fill { fill: var(--aaron, #79b4e8); } .ds-state[data-mark='2'] .ds-state__fill { fill: var(--riley, #f08a9b); } .ds-state[data-mark='3'] .ds-state__fill { fill: #b89fc2; } .ds-state[data-mark='7'] .ds-state__fill { fill: var(--together, #a98bdc); } .ds-state__label { font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: .02em; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: central; fill: var(--empty-label, #76707c); pointer-events: none; } .ds-state:not([data-mark='0']) .ds-state__label { fill: var(--ink, #3b3540); } .ds-state:hover .ds-state__fill { filter: brightness(.96); } .ds-state:focus-visible .ds-state__fill { stroke: var(--focus, #4a8fd0); stroke-width: 3; }

components.name: Note field
components.description: Beige field with a hairline ring, a Muted label, and a tabular counter.
components.css: .ds-note { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 420px; padding: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border-radius: 16px; font-family: Nunito, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-note__label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; color: var(--muted, #857c8a); font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-note__field { width: 100%; min-height: 72px; resize: none; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface2, #f3ede4); color: var(--ink, #3b3540); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line, #e8dfd3); font: 700 1.0625rem/1.35 Nunito, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-note__field::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #857c8a); font-weight: 600; } .ds-note__field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #4a8fd0); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A cream page and a map you color in with two soft crayons. The map is the only big thing on screen; everything else is a pill. Aaron is sky blue, Riley is coral, "together" is lavender, and "both, separately" is the two person colors in diagonal stripes. Text sits in ink on every fill. One theme, light. Copy is rationed to the title, the legend, the chip abbreviations, and "Sign out"; notes live in the sheet. The share card is the same system at 1080×1920, drawn on a canvas from the same palette constants.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, warm-gray puzzle-piece states separated by cream, flat pastel marks.
Pills for every control; 16px cards with one soft shadow for the sheet, dialogs, and login.
Short, literal motion: pop and wipe on a changed state, a sheet rise; instant under reduced motion.

rules.name: One Palette Rule
rules.body: Colors are declared once in src/lib/palette.ts. CSS reads them as custom properties; the share-card renderer reads the constants. No hex elsewhere.

rules.name: Ink-On-Fill Rule
rules.body: Text on any mark is ink. White on these pastels fails contrast.

rules.name: Stripes-Are-Both Rule
rules.body: "Both, separately" is never a third color. It is the two person colors in equal diagonal stripes on every surface, including the share card.

rules.name: No-Copy Rule
rules.body: The main screen carries no explanatory text. The map, the chips, and the legend explain themselves.

dos: Do add color through palette.ts and reference it as a custom property.
Do make every control a pill and every container a 16px card.
Do keep the four marks to sky blue, coral, stripes, lavender, with ink labels.
Do collapse all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a dark theme or a prefers-color-scheme branch.
Don't put panels of copy around the map.
Don't introduce a second typeface or outer shadows beyond the card's.
Don't render the share card from a screenshot; it is drawn from data.
